newsitem.title: USA: Western Ohio Financial names president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Western Ohio Financial names president/CEO.

text.p: Western Ohio Financial Corp said Friday it has appointed John Raisbeck as president and chief executive officer of the company and its unit, Springfield Federal Savings Bank, effective May 7.
A company spokeswoman said Raisbeck replaces C. William Clark, who died on January 5.
Raisbeck has been associated with a number of financial institutions, most recently with Liberty State Bank in Twinsburg, Ohio, the company said.
Western Ohio Financial is also the parent of Mayflower Federal Savings Bank and Seven Hills Savings Association, both based in Cincinnati.
